party_a_statement: Lent professional camera lens worth 35000 INR to B for weekend shoot. B returned it with cracked glass element.
party_b_statement: The lens was already loose and cracked inside the case when handed over to me.

evidence.text: High-res photograph taken 10 minutes before handing lens to B showing pristine front and rear optical elements.
WhatsApp message from B on shoot day: 'Man I am so sorry, my assistant tripped on the tripod and the lens hit the floor. Will get it fixed.'
